# ${module_id} - Accumulated final assurance

## Module contract and selection

@@SELECTION@@

Provide proportionate whole-product assurance for one named release unit by combining whichever final
independent audit and accumulated deterministic safeguard paths risk actually requires.

## Public interface and compatibility boundary

integrated release + ROOT-selected final paths -> complete accumulated audit/safeguard pool. Concrete values and return targets belong to the owning step's configured instance. Private changes do not alter public semantics; update actual consumers for a real contract change.

## Rules, process, recipe actions, and allowed variations

P01–P15 own shared rules. Semantic choices in recipe verbs remain ROOT decisions; test_root only authors declared lane-local contracts. Workers mechanically execute supplied choices and return any missing meaning. Reviewer findings remain open within assigned boundaries. Each governing card cites all actions; member cards cite only their ordered subset. Parameters may select bounded source/test paths and optional profiles, never weaken acceptance or change authority.

| Order | Recipe action ID | Project-specific action/process | Allowed parameterization | Decision owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | M07-A1 | Confirm deliverable acceptance and integration results belong to the declared release unit. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 2 | M07-A2 | Select final audit, accumulated deterministic safeguard, or both from risk; do not add a path merely because this module supports it. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 3 | M07-A3 | If both are selected and independent, launch them concurrently with disjoint result/cache roots. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 4 | M07-A4 | The final audit reviews the accumulated accepted product, not superseded intermediate tips. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 5 | M07-A5 | The full safeguard uses the declared independently runnable units and conservative input map. It checkpoints each completed unit, continues after ordinary failures, records dependency skips, reuses only unaffected PASS credit, and executes every failed, unresolved, change-affected, or uncertain unit in declared order beginning with the earliest member of that set. Include check IDs only when the actual checker/runtime uses them for selection, correlation, or pass-credit reuse. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 6 | M07-A6 | Complete all selected paths and every feasible safeguard unit, then join once into one final result pool; the first failure is never the terminal result by itself. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 7 | M07-A7 | Send that pool to M05 for the release-unit verdict. A regression invalidates only implicated credit. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |

- A material final finding routes through M05 to the owning M02 as one compatible batch and returns
  through affected M04 before M07 executes only the failed, unresolved, input-invalidated, or uncertain
  set beginning with that set's earliest unit.
- A support fault follows M05 support isolation; it does not fabricate a safeguard pass, rerun a green
  product path, or hold a successor whose required release result is independently decidable.
- If M07 is omitted, Section 6 and Section 13 must explain why deliverable checks are sufficient.
- When the current progress-bound step uses M07 in Series 2, configure a distinct checkpoint-resume
  occurrence. It joins accepted Series 1 exits, recalculates invalidation, and runs only the required
  remaining unit set; it must not invoke the normal full safeguard as a disguised restart.
